integrity: The proof separates the infinite theorem from the finite permutation check. The computation verifies the complete six-point group calculation only; the knot-theoretic premises are proved from the Alexander normalization and the cited branched-cover theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies possible component-degree patterns in the stated hyperelliptic branched-cover construction. It does not establish realization of all three patterns, does not distinguish the \((6)\) and \((3,3)\) cases by the mod-two Alexander polynomial, and does not classify integral monodromy conjugacy classes.
title: Only three branch-component patterns for genus-two fibered knots
